verdict.rationale: Pipedream MCP documents its own environment separation: a free "development mode" for Connect, and an `x-pd-environment` header on MCP requests. Together these suggest a non-production environment for testing. The evidence never says development mode isolates data from production, or that tool calls stop hitting real third-party accounts, so true sandbox isolation is unproven. missing for 10: explicit documentation that development is isolated from production data, mock or sandbox API targets instead of live third-party calls, details on separating dev and prod connected accounts, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: you can get started for free in development mode
